permittedClaims: This register records engineering alignment, evidence provenance, artifact integrity, control-objective traceability, and readiness gaps for the named systems and exact source revision.
A final release artifact may be eligible to support an assessment finding only when every fail-closed eligibility condition in this register is satisfied.
prohibitedClaims: This register does not claim CMMC certification, a CMMC Level 2 status, a MET assessor determination, authorization to process CUI, FedRAMP authorization, FDACS approval, or provider compliance beyond retained evidence.
Revision 3 engineering alignment does not replace the Revision 2 and June 2018 baseline incorporated by 32 CFR Part 170.

approvedChangeAutomation.rule: Every approved in-scope change must regenerate a bundle bound to the exact merge commit, pass all objective and artifact-integrity checks, and archive the final non-CUI bundle. Standards changes create a blocking drift record and require reviewed mapping updates; automation never silently changes a governing baseline.

technicalGateCriteria.pass: Every applicable objective has an objective-specific passed or valid not-applicable result, the result artifact is SHA-256 hashed, and the result is bound to the exact release revision.
technicalGateCriteria.fail: At least one objective-specific exact-revision technical result is failed.
technicalGateCriteria.pending: One or more objectives lack an objective-specific exact-revision result; candidate artifacts alone do not pass the gate.

humanReviewCriteria.completion: An authorized organization reviewer or assessor completes the applicable review and records a final signed disposition artifact within the authorized scope.
humanReviewCriteria.pending: No authorized final human disposition artifact has been supplied.

assessmentDispositionPolicy.technicalGreenRule: An objective is technically green only when an objective-specific, exact-revision, hashed test or examination result is present and passed.
assessmentDispositionPolicy.humanPendingRule: Organization review or assessor determination may remain pending without converting a passed technical result to failed. The assessment finding remains not_assessed until the authorized human disposition exists.
assessmentDispositionPolicy.operationalRule: A technically passing control may remain operational while human reconciliation is pending unless law, licensing, safety, security, or an explicit activation policy makes prior human approval a mandatory prerequisite.
assessmentDispositionPolicy.mandatoryPrerequisiteRule: A mandatory legal, licensing, security, or regulatory prerequisite is never bypassed; the protected function remains fail closed and the pending item is reported as pending rather than technically failed.

responsibilityTemplate.responsibility: Provide exact-revision source, configuration, automated test, and provider-export artifacts without representing them as assessor determinations.
Approve scope, policies, procedures, roles, operational records, interviews, risk decisions, and remediation evidence for the organization assessment boundary.
Determine MET, NOT MET, or NOT APPLICABLE only from final evidence in the authorized assessment scope and sign the determination artifact.

responsibilityTemplate.owner: Applicable customer or external tenant owner
responsibilityTemplate.responsibility: Supply customer-controlled configuration, endpoint, personnel, contractual, and operating evidence where the assessed boundary assigns responsibility to the customer.
